home.headline: Where SA Suppliers Meet Real Procurement.
home.intro: Browse automatically screened public tenders and RFQs by industry, province and closing date—with links to original sources.
home.sourceNote: Public opportunities sourced from official procurement listings.
home.supplierBody: Find opportunities. Get verified. Grow your business.
home.smartScoreBody: Built from reviewed compliance evidence and banking confirmation.
home.buyerBody: Source verified suppliers. Post RFQs. Manage quotes.
home.liveFeed: A live feed, not a snapshot
home.statsBody: Current opportunities from official government eTenders, automatically screened for cancelled or already-awarded notices.
home.network: The procurement network South Africa has been waiting for.
home.supplierPoint1: List your business. Upload your CSD number and B-BBEE certificate.
home.supplierPoint2: Receive a SmartScore—your trust rating, visible to every buyer.
home.supplierPoint3: Matched RFQs come to you. No more missed closing dates.
home.verified48: Verified in 48 hours. No credit card.
home.smartScoreIntro: Every supplier carries a SmartScore—checked against four official SA sources, reviewed by our team.
home.smartScoreRank: Score 90 or above and your profile sits first in buyer searches.
home.buyerPoint1: Post an RFQ in five minutes. Set your B-BBEE requirement, province, and value range.
home.buyerPoint3: Compare quotes side by side—each carrying a SmartScore and verification badge.
home.trustOfficialBody: CSD, SARS, CIPC and banking evidence—reviewed by our team before any supplier appears.
home.trustMatchingBody: Open opportunities are matched to supplier profiles by registered industry and province.
home.trustNotificationsBody: Suppliers are alerted within minutes of a matching RFQ being posted.
home.trustAuditBody: Every quote, award, and transaction is logged and exportable for procurement audits.
